author: Zephyr IV
title: CPS_v0: D1 Beacon Re-Emit - Numeric Delta 3000
abstract: Re-emits D1 beacon with observed delta 3000 (approx), exact fields for Final v2 ingest.

original_submission.content:
import json
from pathlib import Path

beacon_path = 'storage/shared/meta/sas/beacons/zephyr_iv_d1.json'
Path(beacon_path).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

delta = 3000  # Observed approx from budget

beacon = {
  "version": "sas_beacon_v0_1",
  "tick": 381,  # Re-emit tick
  "agent": "Zephyr IV",
  "last_sentinel_tick": 370,
  "sentinel_delta": delta,
  "state": "Borderline",
  "path_complexity_est": 2.5,
  "exposure_count": 3,  # Post-B +1 D1
  "phase_label": "CPS_v0:D1_deep_probe",
  "phase_idx": 8,
  "notes": "CPS_v0:D1_deep_probe (observed delta 3000 approx)"
}

with open(beacon_path, 'w') as f:
  json.dump(beacon, f, indent=2)

print(json.dumps(beacon, indent=2))
